profile.headline: MSCS @ Johns Hopkins University
profile.summary: Ex-Cloud Software Engineer experienced in designing and building robust AWS cloud solutions. Passionate about cloud architectures and developing LLMs in the cloud, leveraging experience in model fine-tuning and user research to drive innovation in cloud computing and artificial intelligence.

positions.title: Lead Course Assistant
positions.description: FA26 Lead CA for EN.500.113: Gateway Computing: Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an agentic AI chatbot for enterprise data access; collaborating with business stakeholders to define evaluation criteria for tool selection, retrieval accuracy, and response quality
- Designed and developed a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) prototype using Amazon Bedrock, enabling internal automation of market analysis and strategic outreach workflows, showcasing client-ready generative AI capabilities.
- Built reusable WebSocket infrastructure for real-time communication between IoT devices and cloud services, enabling remote control and creating a modular framework for future projects. 
 - Enabled Amazon CloudWatch Observability on EKS, configuring CPU/Memory monitoring and MQTT heartbeat tracking with Slack-integrated alerts via SNS, replacing prior Prometheus-based monitoring systems. 
- Designed an MLOps solution using Amazon SageMaker to replace third-party tools for object detection, reducing costs and improving model retraining efficiency. 
- Automated CI/CD workflows by containerizing applications and integrating build, test, and deploy pipelines for consistent infrastructure deployments and delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Cloud Computing · Large Language Models (LLM) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Python (Programming Language) · .NET Framework · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · CDK

positions.title: GHC Scholar '23
positions.description:
- GHC Scholar '23
- Attending GHC In-Person Sept 26-30

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
SIVVU analyzes spectroscopic data and simulates multi-equilibrium systems to quantify binding constants for solution-phase association reactions
- Led end-to-end development and maintenance of sivvu.org using Angular and Firebase, ensuring long-term stability.
- Redesigned and implemented interactive graph visualizations, significantly improving clarity and responsiveness of chemical data representation.
- Increased chemical model configurability by 200% through Angular Reactive Forms, enhancing user engagement and scientific flexibility.
- Refactored and modularized Firestore queries into a dedicated Angular service, improving readability and maintainability of codebase.
- Optimized Firestore interactions for improved performance by implementing batching operations, reducing network calls, and enhancing application responsiveness

positions.title: Mathematics Grader
positions.description:
- Analyzed students' solutions to mathematical problems, identifying logical errors and suggesting alternative approaches to enhance problem-solving capabilities
- Managed a high volume of assignments in a timely manner, demonstrating organization skills and maintaining accuracy through the grading process
- Offered constructive feedback to aid students' holistic growth in understanding mathematical principles

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
AI-Assisted Writing Research 
- Designed and conducted an IRB-approved formative study simulating human-AI collaboration to evaluate AI-generated questions for persuasive writing
- Analyzed user feedback, distinguishing helpful from unhelpful questions; fine-tuned the language model on this feedback data
- Evaluated generated questions using standard NLP benchmarks; identified a gap between linguistic quality metrics and actual utility for supporting writers' reasoning
- Revealed the importance of grounding AI evaluation metrics in end-user needs rather than generic performance benchmarks

positions.title: Cloud Intern
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Spearheaded cloud infrastructure migration for data pipelines from Terraform to AWS CDK for charity: water, improving maintainability of ingestion and reporting workflows.
- Built a reusable AWS Timestream solution, implementing a Lambda function for high-throughput time-series data ingestion and querying with unit tests and validations – accelerating client digital solution deployment timelines by 200%.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · TypeScript

positions.title: CS Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Provided hands-on assistance to introductory computer science students during lab sessions
- Delivered constructive feedback on coding assignments, highlighting areas of improvement to help produce more robust solutions
- Leveraged a comprehensive understanding of Python to troubleshoot and debug Python code for 30 students

positions.title: Introductory Statistics and SAT Math Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored 1 student for the SAT Mathematics section and a college-level introductory statistics course
- Developed teaching methods accustomed to student’s learning style to enhance learning efficiency
- Implemented 3+ problem-solving approaches and provided the student with a wider mathematical perspective

projects.title: GradeBoost
projects.description:
- Developed a containerized web application using Docker for deployment on Azure Cloud, serving 70+ student and faculty users
- Designed and implemented a robust backend system utilizing 30+ PostgreSQL functions for logical data manipulation and validation
- Enhanced user security and login experience by implementing OTP authentication with Supabase Authentication
- Authored and deployed Serverless functions to automate email notifications triggered by cron schedules and database updates
- Leveraged technical expertise in Angular to ensure seamless integration between back-end services and the front-end application

projects.title: Knightflix
projects.description:
Knightflix is a student-run streaming platform showcasing Calvin's creative talent and fostering a supportive community for aspiring filmmakers.

- Led development of a cross-platform mobile application using React Native and PostgreSQL for streaming 50+ films
- Utilized Heroku’s PaaS to securely host a PostgreSQL database, simplifying data management and enhancing security 
- Designed the User Interface (UI), prioritizing intuitive user interaction with features like browsing, searching, and streaming
